pages.text: The $(item)Teletype Machine$() sends $(thing)RTTY$() through the radio it touches: type, and it goes out live; weak copy prints garbled. It needs $(item)paper$() (by hand or hopper).$(br2)Its blue $(thing)SOLAR WX$() lamp asks an $(l:radiocraft:sky/ionosphere)Ionospheric Processor$(/l) for the solar report, over the air or directly if one touches it or its radio.

Scroll back up the roll with the wheel, or Page Up and Down. Sneak and right click the machine with an empty hand to tear the $(item)Teletype Roll$() off and keep it: right click the roll to read it anywhere, or right click a teletype whose roll is empty to feed it back in.

pages.name: Teletype station
pages.text: A 20 m station with the teletype beside the radio. Solar panels, controller and battery power it.
